text_en: You were dead through the trespasses and sins
text_cn: 你们从前因着你们的过犯和罪恶是死的；

text_en: in which you once lived, following the course of this world, following the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit that is now at work among those who are disobedient.
text_cn: 那时你们生活在过犯罪恶中，跟随这世界的风气，顺从空中权能的首领，即现今在悖逆之子身上发生作用的恶神。

text_en: All of us once lived among them in the passions of our flesh, following the desires of flesh and senses, and we were by nature children of wrath, like everyone else.
text_cn: 就连我们从前也都在这样环境中生活过，放纵肉身的私欲，照肉身和心意所喜好的行事，且生来就是义怒之子，和别人一样。

text_en: But God, who is rich in mercy, out of the great love with which he loved us
text_cn: 然而富于慈悲的天主，因着他爱我们的大爱，

text_en: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ —by grace you have been saved—
text_cn: 竟在我们因过犯死了的时候，使我们同基督一起生活──可见你们得救，是由于恩宠──

text_en: and raised us up with him and seated us with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
text_cn: 且使我们同他一起复活，在基督耶稣内使我们和他一同坐在天上，

text_en: so that in the ages to come he might show the immeasurable riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 为将自己无限丰富的恩宠，即他在基督耶稣内，对我们所怀有的慈惠，显示给未来的世代。

text_en: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God—
text_cn: 因为你们得救是由于恩宠，藉着信德，所以得救并不是出于你们自己，而是天主的恩惠；

text_en: not the result of works, so that no one may boast.
text_cn: 不是出于功行，免得有人自夸。

text_en: For we are what he has made us, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand to be our way of life.
text_cn: 原来我们是他的化工，是在基督耶稣内受造的，为行天主所预备的各种善工，叫我们在这些善工中度日。

text_en: So then, remember that at one time you Gentiles by birth, called “the uncircumcision” by those who are called “the circumcision”—a physical circumcision made in the flesh by human hands—
text_cn: 所以你们应该记得，你们从前生来本是外邦人，被那些称为受割损的人──割损本是人手在肉身上所行的──称为未受割损的人；

text_en: remember that you were at that time without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
text_cn: 记得那时你们没有默西亚，与以色列社团隔绝，对恩许的盟约是局外人，在这世界上没有希望，没有天主。

text_en: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
text_cn: 但是现今在基督耶稣内，你们从前远离天主的人，藉着基督的血，成为亲近的了。

text_en: For he is our peace; in his flesh he has made both groups into one and has broken down the dividing wall, that is, the hostility between us.
text_cn: 因为基督是我们的和平，他使双方合而为一；他以自己的肉身，拆毁了中间阻隔的墙壁，就是双方的仇恨，

text_en: He has abolished the law with its commandments and ordinances, that he might create in himself one new humanity in place of the two, thus making peace,
text_cn: 并废除了由规条命令所组成的法律，为把双方在自己身上造成一个新人，而成就和平。

text_en: and might reconcile both groups to God in one body through the cross, thus putting to death that hostility through it.
text_cn: 他以十字架诛灭了仇恨，也以十字架使双方合成一体，与天主和好。

text_en: So he came and proclaimed peace to you who were far off and peace to those who were near;
text_cn: 所以他来，向你们远离的人传布了和平的福音，也向那亲近的人传布了和平，

text_en: for through him both of us have access in one Spirit to the Father.
text_cn: 因为藉着他，我们双方在一个圣神内，才得以进到父面前。

text_en: So then you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are citizens with the saints and also members of the household of God,
text_cn: 所以你们已不再是外方人或旅客，而是圣徒的同胞，是天主的家人；

text_en: built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.
text_cn: 已被建筑在宗徒和先知的基础上，而基督耶稣自己却是这建筑物的角石，

text_en: In him the whole structure is joined together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
text_cn: 靠着他，整个建筑物结构紧凑，逐渐扩大，在主内成为一座圣殿；

text_en: in whom you also are built together spiritually into a dwelling place for God.
text_cn: 并且靠着他，你们也一同被建筑，因着圣神，成为天主的住所。
